title: Sharp upper bounds on the $A_α$-spectral radius of graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph with degree diagonal matrix $D(G)$ and adjacency matrix $A(G)$. The signless Laplacian matrix of $G$ is defined as $Q(G)=D(G)+A(G)$. For a real number $α\in [0, 1]$, Nikiforov (2017) proposed the $A_α$-matrix of a graph $G$ as $A_α(G)=αD(G)+(1-α)A(G)$. The $A_α$-spectral radius of $G$, denoted by $ρ_α(G)$, is the largest eigenvalue of $A_α(G)$, where $ρ_0(G)=ρ(G)$ is the spectral radius of $A(G)$ and $2ρ_{\frac{1}{2}}(G)=q(G)$ is the spectral radius of $Q(G)$.
